propositions: recheck-review currently refuses all current-revision findings, including bugfix-size-attestation blocks, even when the attestation has been earned after the block was issued

bugfix-size-attestation findings should be accepted by recheck-review when the ticket's plan-review attestation is present and buckets as accepted (certified, stale-code, or stale-head), because the remedy is ticket-state change, not code change

the NO_CODE_CHANGE label copy condition incorrectly preserves bugfix-size-attestation blocks across patchsets with identical tree but new attestation state, making recheck-review the only viable re-trigger path

recheck-review must verify only the bot's own vote message and ticket store, never the requesting comment, by reading exactly one blocking finding of type bugfix-size-attestation from the vote header and resolving the ticket id from commit-message trailer
blocks containing bugfix-size-attestation plus other blocking findings, or attestations in FLAG_VERDICTS or infra error states, must remain refused
every parse failure in eligibility check (missing header, unparseable count, missing criterion line, unresolvable ticket id, classifier exception) must fail-closed and refuse recheck-review
